claims.statement: Substitutability valuation for the Nabtesco RV-reducer supply edge: 4 of 5. Anchors: Nabtesco's ventures site states 60 percent of the global market for precision reduction gears (self-report verbatim; the corporate page's medium-to-large joints ~60% self-estimate is already in this graph); Shuanghuan Driveline already supplies RV reducers in this graph (Chinese domestic adoption). Rationale for 4: dominant installed base plus qualification/installed-base switching friction, but a named at-scale challenger exists — not sole (not 5), friction too high for 3. Research judgment with both error directions encoded in disproof.
